contributions.note: This is the first closed continuous six-primitive lawfulness theoremlet in this repo branch.

contributions.note: The closed cocycle-pressure route is new in this continuous audited-shell branch and is not inherited from the earlier induced/delayed branches.

contributions.note: The endomap/fixed-point object idea is inherited from six-birds theory, but its continuous full-loop implementation and audit are adapted here.

contributions.label: Canonical hybrid object
contributions.note: The branch packages cocycle pressure, completion, saturation, forcing, and packaged strata into one intrinsic theorem object rather than leaving them as separate diagnostics.

contributions.label: Strict theory extension theoremlet
contributions.note: The abstract six-birds strict-extension idea is closed here as an audited-shell theoremlet on the canonical hybrid object.

contributions.label: Conditional pressure disintegration theoremlet
contributions.note: The branch closes a paper-native conditional disintegration consequence on the canonical hybrid object rather than on a raw trajectory or per-stratum root split.

contributions.label: Audited-shell scope restriction
contributions.note: The branch converts scope discipline into a first-class package artifact instead of leaving shell limits implicit.

contributions.note: The branch explicitly records broader-class ambitions as reserve-only and prevents them from leaking into the core package.

contributions.label: Rejected direct stratumwise separation route
contributions.note: The branch turns the failed stratumwise route into an explicit non-claim and pivots to the paper-native conditional route.

contributions.label: Traceability, claim-ledger, and manuscript-firewall infrastructure
contributions.note: The branch builds publication-facing package controls that the earlier theorem branches and vendor substrate do not provide in this form.

notes: The delta map is conservative: primitive semantics are inherited, continuous substrate mechanics are adapted, and theorem closure is counted as new only where the branch actually closes it.
The external docs/papers baseline directory is absent from this snapshot, so prior-paper comparison is limited to the vendor six-birds PICA materials and in-repo theorem branches.
